description: Find video games by name, on every platform or one. Each match comes with its platform, its page URL and what loose, complete and sealed copies typically sell for.

currency.description: Currency for prices, an ISO 4217 code: USD (the default), EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, PLN and others.

platform.description: A platform slug from list_platforms, e.g. "playstation-2" or "nintendo-switch".

query.description: The game's name or words from it, e.g. "ocarina of time".

name: search_games
title: Search games
